_about: The only place affiliate status and links are stored. Status is one of: approved (we hold an official link; set `link`), pending (we applied and are waiting; no link yet), unavailable (the official page says we cannot join), ordinary (no affiliate relationship; buttons go to the official site). A tool with no entry is ordinary. A link is used ONLY when status is approved. Never invent a link. Details and sources: docs/AFFILIATE_PROGRAMS.md. Regenerate docs/AFFILIATE_STATUS.md with `npm run affiliate:report`.

surfer.note: Programme exists and fits the site; not applied for.

writesonic.note: Programme exists; payout method for Pakistan not stated; not applied for.

hostinger.note: Applications can be rejected for locations outside its focus regions; not applied for.

make.note: Pays only through Wise, which the Wise Pakistan page says residents cannot open; not applied for.

namecheap.note: Commission not stated on its own page; not applied for.

lovable.note: Programme exists; terms partly unstated; not applied for.

canva.note: Help pages say the programme runs on Impact, but its page could not be read (HTTP 403); unverified.

zapier.note: No confirmed affiliate programme (a staff comment in January 2025 said none exists).

heygen.note: Its official page requires 5,000+ followers on one platform and original video content; blog or SEO-only promotion is not allowed.

notion.note: Its official page says the programme is not accepting new affiliates.

jasper.note: Its official page offers an agency Solutions Partner programme and says independent affiliates are not eligible.
